info.title: Aruba Central
info.description:
Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (authorization code grant) via Aruba Central's own OAuth2 provider.

HPE Aruba Networking Central cloud-managed network platform — site, group, and device inventory management, group configuration templates, WLAN (SSID) profiles, guest access portals/visitors, and labels for device organization.

Source: https://developer.arubanetworks.com/central/docs/api-oauth-access-token (auth); operation surface derived from Aruba Central's Configuration/Central/Platform/Guest API families, each of which self-hosts its own per-instance Swagger 2.0 spec (not fetchable without a live tenant).
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 56 of 976 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: sites and site-device associations, groups and group configuration templates, device inventory and group/template-variable assignment, WLAN (SSID) profile CRUD, guest portal and visitor CRUD, and labels with device associations. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

delete.summary: Remove a label association from devices
Remove device association from a site

post.summary: Move devices to a different group

get.summary: Get the group a device is assigned to
Get properties for a set of groups

post.summary: Create a template in a group

patch.summary: Update a template in a group

get.summary: List SSID profiles in a group

post.summary: Create a visitor account for a portal

get.summary: Get a device from inventory by serial

oauth2AuthCode.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant via Aruba Central's own OAuth2 provider (client ID/secret registered against a Central account, per-region API gateway).

device_ids.description: Serial numbers of the devices to (un)associate.

GroupAttributes.description: Group configuration attributes (template/UI mode, password, applicable device architectures) per Aruba Central's Groups configuration API.

security.description: SSID security/auth configuration (WPA mode, passphrase, 802.1X profile, etc).
